title: Minimum Cost to Split into Ones II
description:
You are given an integer `n`.

In one operation, you may split an integer `x` into two positive integers `a` and `b` such that `a + b = x`.

The cost of this operation is `a * b`.

Return the **minimum** total cost required to split the integer `n` into `n` ones.
hints: Analyze the constraints and data structures appropriate for Minimum Cost to Split into Ones II.
Formulate an optimal state transition or traversal invariant.
Consider corner testcases and boundary limits.
